statement: Three or more significant points sharing one bhava mark an unusual concentration of life-area emphasis — distinct from planets simply sharing a rashi (sign), since points can share a bhava while spanning two different signs near a bhava-cusp boundary. Whatever that bhava governs stops being one thread among several and becomes a genuinely central, load-bearing area of life.
editorial_note: Same threshold and point set as the Western house-concentration claim (see astrology/vedic_structural_findings.py) — Lagna excluded since it defines bhava 1's cusp by definition.
